scope: Independent implementation from frozen tokens and block items, all 576 cells and 48 phases, both deltas and 12/11 relation, witnesses, shared unknown map, missingness and tie policy. No new textual/image assessment or normalization.
exposure: Same original image observer, now numerical reviewer; not a third blind expert or additional historical sample. Known catalogue conditional C only. I remains NOT_READY.
algorithm_plan: Split each block into known contiguous token runs at unknown barriers. Build complete-token n-gram index for each run independently, keyed by tuple and returning block/run/start/end/item/token provenance. Query all twelve complete labels against all twelve groups for each of four conditions. Known hit=>1; no hit with any unknown=>NA; otherwise0. Fraction arithmetic for phases and linear coefficient bounds; shared-origin map retained, bounds outer and potentially non-sharp.
separation: Do not import or read engine_v1.py or run_conditional_v1.py. First create and freeze independent replay output from input alone; only then open stored results and compare every requested field. Stored summary is never used as calculation oracle.
outputs: Public safe read-only stdout replay entry and full audit JSON/TXT; files use only repository-relative paths. Inputs read-only and frozen old outputs untouched.
